summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K on 27 May 2026 disclosing routine dividend-equivalent allotments of ordinary shares to PDMRs under the HSBC Share Plan 2011. On 22 May 2026, shares were awarded at an average closing price of £13.3968 (GBP) per share, totaling small volumes (e.g., 4,015 shares to the Group CEO). The filing includes standard UK MAR notifications for each PDMR. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation event is present.
